input.objective: Identify the exact San Francisco city agency responsible for this issue and the official reporting channel with its URL. Issue category: road_pothole. Prefer official city government pages such as sf.gov and 311.
queries: San Francisco report pothole 311 SF Public Works
SF Public Works street repair request

value.title: Report pothole and street issues | SF.gov
value.excerpt: San Francisco Public Works repairs potholes on city maintained streets. Report potholes and street defects through SF 311.

value.title: 311 Customer Service Center | SF.gov
value.excerpt: SF 311 is the city's single point of contact for non emergency service requests. Call 311, use the web forms, or use the SF311 mobile app.
